summary: The notebook has two foundational notes: a course note on gradient descent and a reading note on the Transformer architecture.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: Covers gradient descent basics: the update rule, learning-rate intuition, and a worked quadratic example.
areas.gap: No notes yet on other ML foundations such as linear models, regularization, or generalization.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: Covers the Transformer paper: self-attention, multi-head attention, positional encodings, and WMT translation results.
areas.gap: No notes on other architectures (CNNs, RNNs, diffusion) or training-stability and scaling recipes.
